copy: Draw after sellout. Winning holders claim directly.
days.layout: Four large, beautifully aligned stacked stages. Discreet orange numbers 01, 02, 03, 04 beside the corresponding stage. Thin dividers make a clear sequence. The last copy sentence is a readable footer. Orange is used sparingly, not as large background blocks.
days.caption: Mint activity moves the collection forward. Sellout unlocks the draw; after VRF fulfillment and draw finalization, winning NFT holders can claim directly from the contract. Draw requests and finalization are permissionless transactions. Claims require the holder's wallet action.
days.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Edit the supplied approved Tincta poster into another image in the same official X account launch campaign. Output one finished square poster, preferably 4096 x 4096 or highest supported native square resolution. Preserve the compact lowercase drawn Tincta wordmark at the upper left (about 15% of canvas width), its letter geometry and natural proportions. White #FFFFFF canvas, near-black #111111 modern sans-serif typography, restrained #FF6600 accents. Match the reference's typography, margins and clear hierarchy. Clean editorial design with generous whitespace and precise alignment. Keep text readable on a phone, including qualifications. Do not overcrowd the poster. No photographic mockup, shadows, gradients, rounded app cards, coins, crypto rockets, badges, checkmarks implying audit, logos of other companies, domain names or handles. No Sepolia, testnet, preview or mock labels. Do not claim minting is currently live or add a date, countdown or mint CTA. Do not print the day number. Replace all previous promotional text with ONLY the exact copy specified for this image. Do not carry over the reference's 6 ETH or refund copy unless explicitly listed. Do not invent decorative thin-line artwork: any use of the existing orange ornament must preserve its clean smooth geometry and should be small and secondary.
Composition: Four large, beautifully aligned stacked stages. Discreet orange numbers 01, 02, 03, 04 beside the corresponding stage. Thin dividers make a clear sequence. The last copy sentence is a readable footer. Orange is used sparingly, not as large background blocks.

"Mint."
"Sell out."

copy: Current NFT holders can claim directly.
Refunded NFTs are burned. Gas is not refunded.
days.layout: Two strong headline groups, with 'Claim the mint price back.' the dominant message. Use a small orange rule and the existing orange geometric ornament only as a quiet supporting detail. The two final sentences form an easily readable lower explanatory band separated by a fine line.
days.caption: If a collection expires without selling out, its current NFT holders can claim the original mint price directly from the contract, without owner approval. Each refunded NFT is burned. The refund does not reimburse gas or a secondary-market purchase price. Sold-out collections do not qualify for this unsold refund.
